# Codecademy

> > Codecademy is a free online platform with 50M+ users learning to code through interactive courses in programming, data science, AI, and professional skills.

Codecademy offers comprehensive coding education across multiple programming languages and specializations, from beginner fundamentals to advanced professional development. The platform serves both individual learners and enterprises through Codecademy Teams, with structured skill paths, certification preparation, and real-world project-based learning.

## Key Topics

- Python
- JavaScript
- Web Development
- Data Science
- Machine Learning
- AI & Generative AI
- SQL
- Java
- React
- HTML & CSS
- Career Paths
- Certification Prep
- Skill Development
- Full-Stack Development
- Interview Prep

## Core Platforms

- [Learn to Code - for Free | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com): Codecademy homepage: Free coding platform with 50M+ users learning Python, AI, and professional skills.
- [Codecademy for Business | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/business): Codecademy Teams enterprise solution for corporate upskilling and team training.

## Programming Languages

- [Best Python Courses + Tutorials | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/catalog/language/python): Python courses from basics to advanced with Django, Pandas, and machine learning paths.
- [JavaScript Courses & Tutorials | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/catalog/language/javascript): JavaScript courses covering React, Angular, front-end, and back-end development.
- [Java Courses & Tutorials | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/catalog/language/java): Java programming courses covering OOP, Spring framework, and certification prep.
- [Best HTML + CSS Courses & Tutorials | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/catalog/language/html-css): HTML & CSS web development courses for front-end learning and React fundamentals.
- [C++ (C Plus Plus) Courses & Tutorials | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/catalog/language/c-plus-plus): C++ programming courses from fundamentals to advanced OOP and game development.
- [C# (C Sharp) Courses & Tutorials | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/catalog/language/c-sharp): C# programming courses for web, game development, and ASP.NET applications.

## Specialized Career Paths

- [Web Development Courses | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/catalog/subject/web-development): Full-stack web development courses: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, PHP, and more.
- [Data Science Courses & Tutorials | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/catalog/subject/data-science): Data science courses covering Python, SQL, R, ML/AI, and business intelligence.
- [Machine Learning Courses & Tutorials | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/catalog/subject/machine-learning): Machine learning courses with Python, SQL, Git, and AWS AI certification prep.
- [AI Courses + Training | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/catalog/subject/artificial-intelligence): AI courses covering generative AI, prompt engineering, PyTorch, and NLP.
- [Data Analytics Courses & Tutorials | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/catalog/subject/data-analytics): Data analytics courses with Python, SQL, R, Excel, and business intelligence.
- [Mobile Development Courses & Tutorials | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/catalog/subject/mobile-development): Mobile development courses: iOS/Android, Swift, Kotlin, React Native, Flutter.

## Foundations & Computer Science

- [Code Foundations Courses & Tutorials | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/catalog/subject/code-foundations): Beginner-friendly Code Foundations courses covering JavaScript, Python syntax, and problem-solving.
- [Computer Science Courses & Tutorials | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/catalog/subject/computer-science): Computer science fundamentals: algorithms, data structures, Python, Java, C++.
- [Interview Prep Courses & Tutorials | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/catalog/subject/interview-prep): Technical interview prep for Python, JavaScript, Java, and data structures.

## Design & Professional Development

- [Web Design Courses + Classes | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/catalog/subject/web-design): Web design courses: HTML, CSS, UX/UI, color theory, and Figma prototyping.
- [Professional Skills Courses & Tutorials | Codecademy](https://www.codecademy.com/catalog/subject/professional-skills): Soft skills and professional development courses: leadership, communication, project management.
